title: PEPITEM Reduces Annexin V Immunoreactivity in Spinal Cord Tissue from Experimental Autoimmune Encephalomyelitis Mice.
publicationName: Recent advances in inflammation & allergy drug discovery
journalName: Recent advances in inflammation & allergy drug discovery
snippet: Multiple sclerosis is a chronic autoimmune demyelinating disease of the central nervous system, and experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis is widely used as a murine model to study its immunopathological features.
